title: A swarm of construction nanites builds a bridge in mid-air between two cliff…
content: A swarm of construction nanites builds a bridge in mid-air between two cliff habitats. The structure grows like accelerated coral, lights coming on section by section. Camera flies parallel to the growing span. Sound: insect-like construction chatter, wind. Wonder, photoreal.

---

La cámara vuela en paralelo al tramo en crecimiento. Sonido: parloteo de construcción similar al de insectos, viento. Asombro, fotorrealista.
